goal: Obtain an independent radiation with published branch-length tree, species-level pigment identity, and numeric petal-pathway expression values to replicate the Petunieae within-fine-pigment-class conditional test.
essential_rule: Species-level tree, expression, and measured pigment signatures must join by auditable taxon keys. Article-level trends or photographed figure bars cannot substitute for an exact source numeric matrix.

candidates.original_publication: Larter et al. 2018 Molecular Biology and Evolution
candidates.time_tree_reference: Smith and Goldberg 2015 previously published time-calibrated MCC tree
candidates.next_source_action: Verify 2015 published Smith-Goldberg tree from DOI 10.5061/dryad.0732g and species×7-gene qPCR numeric table from the 2018 MBE article/supplement independently; freeze taxon crosswalk before new expression outcome. Do not substitute 2018 shape study tree or 2019 development source silently.
candidates.distinction: This 2018 comparative qPCR paper is NOT the same source object as Larter et al. 2019 developmental Dvdy Dryad package; a 2019 package cannot be relabeled as 2018 qPCR data.

distinct_2018_shape_tree.use: sensitivity only after frozen published-source crosswalk; never silently substitute for original 2015 tree

candidates.access_note: Current Dryad client documentation states file/archive downloading may require authenticated access; previous anonymous 2019 frozen-source attempts did not recover exact objects. Authentication is not assumed to be connected.

candidates.use_policy: Retain original HOLD; do not change the frozen exact-profile denominator or claim this 2019 source fills the 2018 qPCR replication table.

candidates.next_source_action: Do not admit for expression-memory replication until independent full species-by-gene expression table and source tree are found.
Do not merge it into Iochrominae/Petunieae evidence or treat cross-species transcriptomes as a matched pigment network.
Retain as independent biological prior art, not a sufficiently powered identical-phylogeny replication of the Petunieae estimate.

scientific_boundary: The 2018 and 2019 Iochrominae study objects are separate. No independent replication is added, and no prior HOLD changes. The 47-tip Petunieae result remains one retrospective same-phylogeny analysis, not a general law.
